gloss: to grow thickly; to be overgrown; to be lush

definitions.gloss: to grow thickly; to be overgrown; to be lush
definitions.explanation: For plants, trees, or vegetation to grow densely and abundantly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|お}い{茂|しげ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。

examples.english: The trees in the garden grew so thickly that sunlight stopped getting in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱帯|ねったい}{雨林|うりん}→熱帯雨林：19014_nettaiurin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{巨大|きょだい}→巨大：02586_kyodai⟧な⟦{木々|きぎ}→木々：04811_kigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|お}い{茂|しげ}り、⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}かない→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: In the tropical rainforest, enormous trees grow thickly, and almost no light reaches the ground.

notes:
A literary and descriptive verb that paints a vivid picture of dense, luxuriant vegetation. Composed of {生|お}⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (to grow) and ⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧ (to be thick/lush). It is frequently used in novels, nature descriptions, and travel writing. Often appears in the て-form ({生|お}い{茂|しげ}って) to describe a state.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|お}い{茂|しげ}る: grass grows thickly
- ⟦{木々|きぎ}→木々：04811_kigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|お}い{茂|しげ}る: trees grow lush
- ⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|お}い{茂|しげ}る: weeds become overgrown
- ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{生|お}い{茂|しげ}る: greenery flourishes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茂|しげ}る→茂る：03924_shigeru⟧: to grow thick; to be dense — the simpler form, also used for vegetation but less emphatic
- ⟦{繁茂|はんも}→繁茂：17007_hanmo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to grow densely — a more scientific or formal synonym
- ⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧: to grow; to sprout — focuses on new growth emerging, not density
